summary.zh-CN: 稿子进、成片出：切句打字幕、关键词逐词动画、每 8-12 秒一张海报帧、音效与质检。
summary.en: Script in, film out: captions with per-word animation, a poster frame every 8-12s, sfx and checks.

details.zh-CN: 给口播稿：断句与分行、关键词识别与三级重点、按语速定时、生成带逐词动画的 WebVTT 字幕轨、生成层级排版海报帧页面、合成 whoosh/impact/riser 音效，最后检查字幕覆盖率、海报间隔、响度与越界。所有默认值来自六条真实抖音口播片的逐帧测量，规则文件在 references/rules.md。
details.en: From a script: sentence and line splitting, keyword levels, timing, an animated WebVTT caption track, poster-frame pages, sfx, and checks for coverage, poster spacing and loudness.

needs.zh-CN: Node 20+；ffprobe 仅用于非 wav 旁白与响度检查。
needs.en: Node 20+; ffprobe only for non-wav narration and loudness.
